lines.text: Peter will always remind them, refreshing their memory as long as he lives in the tent of his body.
Peter knows his tent will soon be laid aside, as the elders in Jerusalem made clear to him.
Peter says they were eyewitnesses of Christ's majesty, when the voice from the Majestic Glory called Him God's beloved Son.
They heard the voice from heaven on the Mount of Olives, and the prophets' word is a lamp.
No prophecy of Scripture comes from one's own interpretation, because men spoke from God, carried along by the Holy Spirit.
